subject.title: feat: disable automatic session resets by default

question: Should existing installations that omit session.reset intentionally stop receiving automatic daily session rollover on upgrade, with compaction as the only default context boundary?
rationale: This is an intentional behavior change for persisted user setups rather than a mechanical bug fix; the PR body asserts approval, but the supplied visible discussion does not independently record the durable product and upgrade decision.

options.title: Adopt default none after repair
options.body: Confirm the upgrade contract, repair the two lifecycle defects, and land with proof that unconfigured sessions persist while explicit daily and idle policies retain their behavior.

options.title: Keep daily for existing implicit setups
options.body: Retain the current implicit daily behavior and expose no-reset only through an explicit configuration choice or an intentionally designed migration path.

options.title: Pause for session-policy design
options.body: Defer the default change until maintainers decide the desired continuity, compaction, and operator-expectation contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt default none after repair
recommendation.body: Confirm the upgrade contract, repair the two lifecycle defects, and land with proof that unconfigured sessions persist while explicit daily and idle policies retain their behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored and self-assigned the policy and session-lifecycle change, and the PR body attributes the direction to owner approval.
